questions.q: How many keys does a standard full-size piano have?
questions.fact: A full keyboard stretches across more than seven octaves.

questions.q: About what whole-number percentage of Earth's surface is ocean?
questions.fact: The separate ocean basins form one connected ocean.

questions.q: About what percentage of Earth's water is in the ocean?
questions.fact: Only a small share lies outside the ocean.

questions.q: How long is an official marathon in kilometres?
questions.fact: The distance is also 26 miles and 385 yards.

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.fact: Two serve the gills and one serves the rest of the body.

questions.q: How tall is the Eiffel Tower with its 2022 antenna, in metres?
questions.fact: The new antenna lifted the tower from 324 to 330 metres.

questions.q: How many rivets hold the Eiffel Tower together?
questions.fact: Those rivets join over eighteen thousand iron parts.

questions.q: How many iron parts make up the Eiffel Tower?
questions.fact: Each part was prepared before assembly on site.

questions.q: How many metric tonnes does the Eiffel Tower’s metal frame weigh?
questions.fact: The complete tower weighs more than its frame alone.

questions.q: How many steps run from the Eiffel Tower’s esplanade to its top?
questions.fact: The upper stairway is not open to visitors.

questions.q: How many steps can visitors climb to the Eiffel Tower’s second floor?
questions.fact: Going higher requires a lift.

questions.q: How long is the Golden Gate Bridge’s main span, in metres?
questions.fact: This is the gap between its two main towers.

questions.q: How long is the Golden Gate Bridge including its approaches, in metres?
questions.fact: The main suspension span is only part of the full crossing.

questions.q: How high above the water are the Golden Gate Bridge’s towers, in metres?
questions.fact: The towers support two huge main cables.

questions.q: How many individual steel wires are bundled into ONE Golden Gate Bridge main cable?
questions.fact: Each main cable contains 61 bundles of wires.

questions.q: About how many kilometres of wire are in BOTH Golden Gate Bridge main cables?
questions.fact: All that wire is packed into just two main cables.

questions.q: How many windows are in the Statue of Liberty’s crown?
questions.fact: The windows sit below seven rays.

questions.q: About how tall is the Statue of Liberty from ground to torch tip, in metres?
questions.fact: The figure includes her pedestal.

questions.q: How long is the Statue of Liberty’s nose, in centimetres?
questions.fact: The official measurement is 1.37 metres.

questions.q: How long is the Statue of Liberty’s index finger, in centimetres?
questions.fact: One finger is taller than most people.

questions.q: How many Earth days does Mercury take to orbit the Sun?
questions.fact: Mercury has the shortest year of any planet.

questions.q: To the nearest whole day, how many Earth days make a Venus year?
questions.fact: Venus takes about 224.7 Earth days to orbit the Sun.

questions.q: How many Earth days make a Mars year?
questions.fact: Mars takes nearly two Earth years to circle the Sun.

questions.q: About how many Earth years make one Jupiter year?
questions.fact: Its orbit takes about 4,331 Earth days.

questions.q: About how many Earth years make one Neptune year?
questions.fact: Neptune takes about 59,800 days to orbit the Sun.

questions.q: What is the Moon’s diameter to the nearest kilometre in NASA’s fact sheet?
questions.fact: The Moon is much narrower than Earth.

questions.q: What is Mars’s equatorial diameter to the nearest kilometre?
questions.fact: Mars is just over half as wide as Earth.

questions.q: What is Jupiter’s equatorial diameter to the nearest kilometre?
questions.fact: The solar system’s largest planet is more than ten Earths across.

questions.q: About how many kilometres separate Earth and the Moon on average?
questions.fact: NASA’s table rounds the mean distance to 0.384 million kilometres.

questions.q: About how many million kilometres is Earth from the Sun on average?
questions.fact: That mean distance is called one astronomical unit.

questions.q: How many hours does a Jupiter day last, to one decimal place?
questions.fact: The largest planet spins surprisingly quickly.

questions.q: About how cold is the mean temperature on Mars, in degrees Celsius?
questions.fact: This is a mean value; local temperatures vary enormously.

questions.q: How many steps lead to Big Ben’s belfry in Elizabeth Tower?
questions.fact: The clock faces are lower, at step 281.

questions.q: About how tall is London’s Elizabeth Tower, in metres?
questions.fact: Big Ben is the bell inside the tower.

questions.q: How tall is Dubai’s Burj Khalifa to its architectural top, in metres?
questions.fact: The tower opened in 2010.

questions.q: How high are all three sections of Yosemite Falls together, in metres?
questions.fact: The upper fall, cascades and lower fall combine into one huge drop.

questions.q: How tall is the General Sherman tree, to one decimal place in metres?
questions.fact: Its claim to fame is trunk volume, rather than record height.

questions.q: What is the General Sherman tree’s maximum trunk diameter at its base, in metres?
questions.fact: The base is broader than a typical room.

questions.q: What time did Usain Bolt run for 100 metres in Berlin in 2009?
questions.fact: He ran it on 16 August 2009.

questions.q: What time did Usain Bolt run for 200 metres in Berlin in 2009?
questions.fact: The 200-metre final came four days after his 100-metre final.

questions.q: How far did Mike Powell jump at the 1991 World Championships?
questions.fact: The jump won a famous contest against Carl Lewis.

questions.q: How tall was Robert Wadlow at his final 1940 measurement, in centimetres?
questions.fact: Wadlow was taller than a standard indoor doorway.

questions.q: How many years did Charles Osborne’s famous hiccup attack last?
questions.fact: The attack began in 1922.

questions.q: How long was the single noodle measured in Nanyang, China, in 2017?
questions.fact: One noodle stretched for more than three kilometres.

questions.q: How big was Airrack’s January 2023 record pizza, to the nearest square metre?
questions.fact: Its measured area was 1,296.72 square metres.

questions.q: How long was Stewie the cat at his 2010 record measurement, in centimetres?
questions.fact: His full name was Mymains Stewart Gilligan.

questions.q: How high was Zeus the Michigan Great Dane at the shoulder, in centimetres?
questions.fact: Standing on his hind legs, he reached 223 centimetres.

questions.q: What was the combined length of Diana Armstrong’s fingernails in March 2022, rounded to centimetres?
questions.fact: The measured total across both hands was 1,306.58 centimetres.

questions.q: About how tall can a male giraffe grow, in metres?
questions.fact: Females can reach about 4.3 metres.

questions.q: About how wide is a giraffe’s foot, in centimetres?
questions.fact: That is roughly the width of a dinner plate.

questions.q: At the long end of its usual range, how many months is an elephant pregnant?
questions.fact: San Diego Zoo gives a gestation range of 20 to 22 months.

questions.q: How long can one cheetah stride be, at the upper end in metres?
questions.fact: San Diego Zoo describes a stride of 6 to 6.7 metres.

questions.q: About how many milligrams does a newborn giant Pacific octopus weigh?
questions.fact: A hatchling begins life just over a quarter-inch long.

questions.q: How tall is the Statue of Unity itself, without its base, in metres?
questions.fact: It honours Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

questions.q: How tall is the London Eye, in metres?
questions.fact: The wheel opened to the public in 2000.

questions.q: How many passenger capsules were built for the London Eye?
questions.fact: The capsules represent London’s boroughs.

questions.q: According to NOAA, about how deep is Challenger Deep in metres?
questions.fact: It lies in the Mariana Trench in the western Pacific.

questions.q: According to the NPS visitor page, how deep is Crater Lake at its deepest, in metres?
questions.fact: The deepest lake in the United States fills a volcanic basin.

questions.q: How many kilograms did Schreiber Foods’ record mac-and-cheese portion weigh?
questions.fact: The recipe used over nine hundred kilograms of dry pasta.

questions.q: How long was the giant ice-cream serving scoop measured in Italy in 2015, in centimetres?
questions.fact: This record measured the serving tool, not a scoop of ice cream.
